candidate_relations.rationale: The authority-grant conformance tests strengthen the runtime proposition by exercising issuance limits, revocation behavior, and exact-head concurrency around the same grant lifecycle.
The measured isolation trial's zero source-tree fallback violations and no canonical mutation strengthen the execution record reporting successful isolated installed-runtime invocation.
The measured isolation trial independently strengthens the production-invocation proposition that installed runtime operates without source-repository fallback and does not mutate Canon.
The mutation runtime's explicit proposal-revalidation classifications and artifact validation strengthen the design proposition requiring deterministic pre-approval applicability classification.
The completion record that G1 through G10 passed strengthens the implementation-conformance plan's proposition that those gates were completed.
Rejecting the legacy validated_by relation strengthens the output-schema proposition that only the four accepted relation types are permitted.
Rejecting the removed proposition-level authority field strengthens the output-schema restriction against unsupported graph vocabulary.
Deterministic projection rebuild from valid untouched history strengthens the architecture proposition that append-only history is authoritative and projections are derived state.
The exact-proposal grant constraint is a concrete authority guard that strengthens the broader Human-to-Agent proposition that conversation cannot create additional authority.
The operator-management permission for grant-derived approval remains valid only when the Human-to-Agent grant rule covers the exact proposal.
Production-invocation tests that leave project authority and Canon unchanged strengthen the contract restriction denying Distiller reconciliation and admission authority.
Rupi update/recovery tests that stop on managed drift and preserve project-owned authority strengthen the install-package plan's fail-closed update and no-silent-project-migration guarantees.
Recovery tests that fail closed on malformed journals and avoid touching project-owned files strengthen the package-update recovery and integrity failure guarantees.

Deriving checkpoint completion from exact primitive statuses strengthens the proposition that the checkpoint adapter deterministically reflects accepted primitive results rather than inventing mutations.
Human-Agent tests that keep final control return as an explicit adapter boundary strengthen the Rupi checkpoint proposition that control return is routed through the accepted primitive.
Reproducible clean package builds with allowlisted manifest content strengthen the install-package proposition that manifest content identity is the semantic identity of installed content.
